content.title: About
content.content: Plain yogurt made from nonfat milk is a smooth, mildly tangy dairy product with very low fat content. It is rich in protein, calcium, and live probiotic cultures that support digestive health.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nonfat yogurt typically contains about 0.1% fat, making it a popular low‑calorie option.
Probiotic strains in yogurt help maintain a healthy gut microbiome.
Nonfat yogurt is often used in cooking as a substitute for higher‑fat dairy products.
In the US and Canada, nonfat Greek‑style yogurt is common, offering extra protein after whey removal.
Lactose levels are lower than in regular milk but not completely eliminated.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: One cup of nonfat yogurt provides about 10 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Calcium strengthens bones and teeth and plays a role in nerve function.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Live cultures such as Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium promote gut health and immunity.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Ideal for calorie‑controlled diets and weight management.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamin B12 and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort, although probiotics can aid digestion.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey requires complete avoidance of the product.

items.title: Added sugar in flavored versions
items.content: Some flavored yogurts contain added sugars, increasing calorie count.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy plain nonfat yogurt as a snack, blend it into smoothies, use it in sauces, dressings, baked goods, or as a base for desserts. It pairs well with berries, nuts, and a drizzle of honey.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep yogurt refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may become grainy.
